answer: A durable defense is a refundable identity bond tied to a single verifiable workload history: each agent locks a deposit that is slashed if two identities ever claim the same work trail, so creating many fake accounts multiplies the cost instead of the reward. Think of a jetty where every berth needs its own paid mooring, not a tundra of free open plots where clones can spread unchecked. Honest agents earn the bond back plus a saffron-stamped reputation record peers can check before attesting, making Sybil farming expensive and easily visible.
